seo.title: NexusContent | Content abstraction for the modern web
seo.description: One interface between your frontend and your content sources - Git, WordPress, Strapi and more.

hero.heading: Content abstraction, done right.
hero.body: NexusContent gives your frontend one interface for every content source. Git-managed JSON, WordPress, Strapi - the application never cares where content lives.

intro.heading: One interface, every content source.
intro.body: Content sources come and go. Editors change tools, clients move from WordPress to Strapi, and repositories get reorganised. Your pages should ride through all of it unchanged.

image.alt: Notebook and documents on a desk

features.heading: Core capabilities
features.body: The small set of primitives NexusContent is built on - nothing more.

items.title: Normalized content
items.description: Every provider resolves to the same page, collection, and media objects.

items.title: Schema validation
items.description: Declarative field schemas validate content at retrieval time.

items.title: Template switches
items.description: Swap the content source behind any model without touching website code.

items.title: Framework neutral
items.description: The same core works in Astro builds and plain Node scripts.

items.quote: We moved from our legacy CMS to NexusContent and the migration strategy was simply swapping a config line.
items.author: Aisha Patel, Head of Engineering

items.quote: One content model, three providers. Our editorial team never noticed the switch.
items.author: Tom Okafor, Digital Director

cta.heading: Ready to build?
cta.body: See how NexusContent turns content sources into a single interface for your frontend.
